The expression vocabulary

Source: R/vocabulary-doc.R
vocabulary.Rd

Clauses of the bracket are written in a closed vocabulary of typed functions: SQL's names, with R's spellings as synonyms. A function outside it is a zutable_type_error at plan time; r(expr, type) evaluates arbitrary R in the local executor, with its result type declared and checked.

Details

Where R and SQL differ the vocabulary chooses one rule, the same in every engine: a double's NA is the missing value and NaN a value, equal to itself and above every number; strings compare by bytes; aggregates skip missing values and give NA over none; int32 arithmetic that overflows is an error; paste0() gives NA when any part is NA; ifelse() gives NA for an NA condition, while case() skips it; substr() takes R's start and stop. A literal takes the type of its context when it is exactly representable there, so qty + 1 is int32 and day >= "2026-01-01" compares dates.

Functions

Every function allowed in a clause, with the argument and result types it takes. T is one type throughout a signature.

+

Arithmetic. Types: (int32, int32) -> int32; (float64, float64) -> float64; (int32, float64) -> float64; (float64, int32) -> float64; (date, int32) -> date; (int32, date) -> date.

-

Arithmetic. Types: (int32, int32) -> int32; (float64, float64) -> float64; (int32, float64) -> float64; (float64, int32) -> float64; (date, int32) -> date; (date, date) -> int32; (int32) -> int32; (float64) -> float64.

*

Arithmetic. Types: (int32, int32) -> int32; (float64, float64) -> float64; (int32, float64) -> float64; (float64, int32) -> float64.

/

Arithmetic; always float64. Types: (int32, int32) -> float64; (float64, float64) -> float64; (int32, float64) -> float64; (float64, int32) -> float64.

%/%

Floor division; a zero int32 divisor gives NA. Types: (int32, int32) -> int32; (float64, float64) -> float64; (int32, float64) -> float64; (float64, int32) -> float64.

%%

Modulo with the divisor's sign. Types: (int32, int32) -> int32; (float64, float64) -> float64; (int32, float64) -> float64; (float64, int32) -> float64.

^

Power, as R's ^; always float64. Types: (int32, int32) -> float64; (float64, float64) -> float64; (int32, float64) -> float64; (float64, int32) -> float64.

abs

Types: (int32) -> int32; (float64) -> float64.

sqrt

Types: (int32) -> float64; (float64) -> float64.

exp

Types: (int32) -> float64; (float64) -> float64.

log

Natural logarithm. Types: (int32) -> float64; (float64) -> float64.

round

Rounding half to even, as R. Types: (int32) -> int32; (float64) -> float64; (int32, int32) -> int32; (float64, int32) -> float64.

floor

Types: (int32) -> int32; (float64) -> float64.

ceiling

Types: (int32) -> int32; (float64) -> float64.

==

Comparison. Types: (T, T) -> bool; (int32, float64) -> bool; (float64, int32) -> bool; (timestamp, timestamp) -> bool.

!=

Comparison. Types: (T, T) -> bool; (int32, float64) -> bool; (float64, int32) -> bool; (timestamp, timestamp) -> bool.

<

Comparison. Types: (T, T) -> bool; (int32, float64) -> bool; (float64, int32) -> bool; (timestamp, timestamp) -> bool.

<=

Comparison. Types: (T, T) -> bool; (int32, float64) -> bool; (float64, int32) -> bool; (timestamp, timestamp) -> bool.

>

Comparison. Types: (T, T) -> bool; (int32, float64) -> bool; (float64, int32) -> bool; (timestamp, timestamp) -> bool.

>=

Comparison. Types: (T, T) -> bool; (int32, float64) -> bool; (float64, int32) -> bool; (timestamp, timestamp) -> bool.

between

Lo <= x <= hi. Types: (T, T, T) -> bool; (int32, float64, float64) -> bool; (float64, int32, int32) -> bool.

&

Three-valued and. Types: (bool, bool) -> bool.

|

Three-valued or. Types: (bool, bool) -> bool.

!

Not. Types: (bool) -> bool.

is.na

Missing; NaN is a value, not missing. Also spelt is_null. Types: (bool) -> bool; (int32) -> bool; (float64) -> bool; (string) -> bool; (date) -> bool; (timestamp) -> bool; (enum) -> bool; (binary) -> bool; (list) -> bool; (struct) -> bool; (int64) -> bool; (decimal) -> bool.

coalesce

The first value that is not missing. Types: (T, ...) -> T.

ifelse

An NA condition gives NA, as in R. Types: (bool, T, T) -> T.

nchar

Number of characters. Also spelt length. Types: (string) -> int32.

upper

Also spelt toupper. Types: (string) -> string.

lower

Also spelt tolower. Types: (string) -> string.

substr

Characters start to stop, as R's substr(). Types: (string, int32, int32) -> string.

concat

Joins strings; NA if any is NA. Also spelt paste0. Types: (string, ...) -> string.

trim

Removes spaces, tabs and line breaks at both ends. Also spelt trimws. Types: (string) -> string.

like

SQL LIKE: % any run, _ one character. Types: (string, string) -> bool.

starts_with

Also spelt startsWith. Types: (string, string) -> bool.

year

Types: (date) -> int32; (timestamp) -> int32.

month

Types: (date) -> int32; (timestamp) -> int32.

day

Types: (date) -> int32; (timestamp) -> int32.

date_trunc

The start of the year, quarter, month, week (Monday), day, hour, minute or second. Types: (string, date) -> arg2; (string, timestamp) -> arg2.

count

Aggregate. Rows, or values that are not missing. Types: () -> int32; (bool) -> int32; (int32) -> int32; (float64) -> int32; (string) -> int32; (date) -> int32; (timestamp) -> int32; (enum) -> int32; (binary) -> int32; (list) -> int32; (struct) -> int32; (int64) -> int32; (decimal) -> int32.

count_distinct

Aggregate. Distinct values that are not missing. Also spelt n_distinct. Types: (bool) -> int32; (int32) -> int32; (float64) -> int32; (string) -> int32; (date) -> int32; (timestamp) -> int32; (enum) -> int32.

sum

Aggregate. Always float64. Types: (int32) -> float64; (float64) -> float64.

mean

Aggregate. Also spelt avg. Types: (int32) -> float64; (float64) -> float64.

min

Aggregate. Types: (bool) -> arg1; (int32) -> arg1; (float64) -> arg1; (string) -> arg1; (date) -> arg1; (timestamp) -> arg1.

max

Aggregate. Types: (bool) -> arg1; (int32) -> arg1; (float64) -> arg1; (string) -> arg1; (date) -> arg1; (timestamp) -> arg1.

first

Aggregate. The first value, missing or not. Types: (T) -> T.

last

Aggregate. The last value, missing or not. Types: (T) -> T.

any

Aggregate. Types: (bool) -> bool.

all

Aggregate. Types: (bool) -> bool.

%in%

Membership in a set of constants; NA for a missing value.

case

condition ~ value pairs and .default; an NA condition is skipped.

cast

Conversion that errors on the first value it cannot represent.
